1. Navigate to **Inventory > Configuration > Locations**.
2. Assign an **Analytic Account** to the locations you wish to track.
3. Perform a stock movement (e.g., an internal transfer or delivery)
   involving these locations.
4. Once the picking is validated and marked as **Done**, check the
   **Analytic Items** in Accounting to see the automatically generated
   lines reflecting the inventory value change.
